summary.text: The échoppe, a tool with a slanted oval section, is also used for "swelling" lines.

Callot's second innovation was the echoppe, a steel cylinder honed to a slant at the end … By twisting this slanted oval while drawing on the grounded copper, he started a line slim and then swelled it the way an engraved line swells.

source.author: A. Hyatt Mayor
source.title: Prints & People: A Social History of Printed Pictures
